body.text: The IHT transports heat to the NSS for electrical power generation and energy storage during normal operation.
body.anchor: transports heat from the primary coolant to the Nuclear Island Salt System (NSS)

body.text: It transports heat to the IAC for rejection to the atmosphere during start-up and shutdown, as the normal and preferred means of reactor cooling.
body.anchor: as the normal and preferred means of providing reactor cooling

body.text: On loss of pumped flow, the IHT provides natural circulation for decay heat removal through the IAC AHXs.
body.anchor: In the event of a loss of pumped flow

checks.q: What is the normal and preferred means of reactor cooling during start-up and shutdown?
o: Transport of heat through the IHT to the IAC
checks.x: IHT to IAC is the normal and preferred means.
checks.anchor: as the normal and preferred means of providing reactor cooling

body.text: Each of the two loops has an ISP, an array of SHXs, and interconnecting piping. Each loop connects to one IHX and one IAC AHX.
body.anchor: Each loop includes an Intermediate Sodium Pump (ISP), an array of Sodium-Salt Heat Exchangers

body.text: Supporting equipment includes expansion tanks and a drain subsystem.
body.anchor: The IHT supporting equipment includes expansion tanks and a drain subsystem

body.text: Loop piping and components are in the Reactor Auxiliary Building, except piping in the Reactor Building to the IHX nozzles and yard piping to the AHXs.
body.anchor: The system loop piping and components are located within the Reactor Auxiliary Building

body.text: The expansion tank interfaces with the SCG for an inert cover gas and overpressure protection, and with the SPS for sodium processing.
body.anchor: to prevent sodium-air interaction and to provide IHT over-pressure protection

body.text: IHT piping in the HAA has a continuous leak guard as a secondary barrier.
body.anchor: includes a continuous leak guard enclosing the pipe as a secondary barrier

body.alt: PSAR Rev 1 figure: Intermediate Loop Simplified Diagram

checks.q: What does each IHT loop connect to?
o: One IHX and one IAC AHX
checks.x: Each loop connects to one PHT IHX and one IAC AHX.
checks.anchor: Each intermediate loop connects to one Primary Heat Transport System

checks.q: What protects HAA equipment from an IHT pipe leak?
o: A continuous leak guard around the pipe
checks.x: The piping in the HAA has a continuous leak guard.
checks.anchor: includes a continuous leak guard enclosing the pipe as a secondary barrier

body.text: ISP speed controls loop flow, through an adjustable speed drive that varies frequency and voltage.
body.anchor: Intermediate loop sodium flow rate is controlled by controlling ISP speed

body.text: IAC Active Mode uses ISP flow. When ISPs are not available, Blower Mode and Passive Mode use natural circulation of intermediate sodium.
body.anchor: the IHT is designed to support IAC heat rejection in Blower Mode and Passive Mode through natural circulation

body.text: The elevation difference between the IHX and the higher AHX drives natural circulation flow.
body.anchor: provides the potential energy to drive natural circulation flow

rows.anchor: The intermediate sodium of IHT is maintained at higher pressure
IHT pressure is maintained at a lower pressure than NSS

checks.q: In an SHX leak, which way does the coolant flow?
checks.x: IHT pressure is lower than NSS, so NSS coolant flows to the intermediate loop.
checks.anchor: IHT pressure is maintained at a lower pressure than NSS

checks.q: What drives natural circulation in the IHT?
o: Elevation difference between the IHX and the AHX
checks.x: The elevation difference provides the potential energy.
checks.anchor: provides the potential energy to drive natural circulation flow

body.text: Two trip circuit breakers are in series in the power supply to each ISP motor.
body.anchor: Two trip circuit breakers are installed in series

body.text: The siphon-break feature limits intermediate sodium entering the primary system in an IHX leak, to prevent reactor vessel overfill.
body.anchor: siphon-break feature is designed to limit the volume of intermediate sodium

checks.q: Which condition trips only the associated ISP?
o: Low level in an IHT expansion tank
checks.x: Low expansion tank level trips the associated ISP.
checks.anchor: Low level in an IHT expansion tank (trips associated ISP)

checks.q: What prevents reactor vessel overfill in an IHX leak?
checks.x: The siphon-break feature limits the sodium introduced to prevent overfill.
checks.anchor: siphon-break feature is designed to limit the volume of intermediate sodium

body.text: IHT piping, tanks, and SHXs are NSRST. The ISP trip circuit breaker and trip actuator are SR.
body.anchor: ISP Trip Circuit Breaker, Trip SR SCS1

body.text: No manual operator actions or automatic actuations are needed for the IHT passive heat removal function.
body.anchor: No manual operator actions or automatic actuations are required for the IHT to perform its passive heat removal

checks.q: What is the classification of the ISP trip circuit breaker?
checks.x: Table 7.1.4-1 lists the ISP trip circuit breaker as SR.
checks.anchor: ISP Trip Circuit Breaker, Trip SR SCS1

checks.q: What does manual ISP trip back up?
checks.x: DL4-HR7 is an operator manual trip as backup to the SR automatic trip.

body.text: The IHT provides instrumentation for expansion tank level signals and ISP trip circuit breaker status.
body.anchor: provides instrumentation required for expansion tank level signals and ISP trip circuit breaker status

body.text: Sodium-salt reaction effects from an SHX leak are the subject of research and development.
body.anchor: The effects of the sodium-salt reaction due to a postulated leak in the SHX

checks.q: Which IHT indication helps diagnose sodium loss from a loop?
checks.x: The IHT provides expansion tank level signals.
checks.anchor: provides instrumentation required for expansion tank level signals and ISP trip circuit breaker status

summary.text: The IHT has two loops, each with an ISP, SHXs, and connections to one IHX and one AHX.
summary.anchor: Each loop includes an Intermediate Sodium Pump (ISP), an array of Sodium-Salt Heat Exchangers

summary.text: IHT pressure sits above primary and below salt.
summary.anchor: IHT pressure is maintained at a lower pressure than NSS

summary.text: ISP trips are on low expansion tank level, and high high primary sodium level or temperature.
summary.anchor: High-High primary sodium level (trips both ISPs)

title: Intermediate Heat Transport System
subject: IHT
intro: The IHT carries heat from the IHXs to the salt system at power and to the air heat exchangers at low power and shutdown. It has two loops, and either pumped or natural circulation flow.
